name: Mango-III aptamer bound to TO1-Biotin
source: RCSB PDB 6E8T; Trachman RJ et al. Nat Chem Biol 2019 doi:10.1038/s41589-018-0184-5
notes: Mango-III (A10U variant) fluorogenic aptamer. Ligand HZG (TO1-Biotin). Tetrameric crystal structure (chains A-D); use chain A. 2.90A X-ray. Companion to Mango-II (6C64).
affinitySource: Trachman et al. 2019; Kd ~3 nM for TO1-Biotin
